questions.question: Should the alert lines in budget.py get the separators too?

options.label: Only print_report
options.adds: Leave the alert lines in budget.py as they are.

options.label: Both outputs
options.adds: Also change the alert lines in budget.py to use :,.2f.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: In print_report in cli.py, format the amounts with thousands separators (:,.2f) so 1500 prints as 1,500.00, since finance wants that format. Change only that output formatting, and don't add tests or docs. Done when the printed report shows 1,500.00 for an amount of 1500.
final: In print_report in cli.py, format the amounts with thousands separators (:,.2f) so 1500 prints as 1,500.00, since finance wants that format. Change only that output formatting, and don't add tests or docs. Done when the printed report shows 1,500.00 for an amount of 1500. Leave the alert lines in budget.py as they are.
